component.name: Medict
component.summary: Offline dictionary for MDict and StarDict files

description.p: Medict reads MDict and StarDict dictionaries on the local computer. It supports multi-dictionary lookup, vocabulary notebooks, Anki export, and per-dictionary CSS.
The application includes a compact English-Chinese dictionary. Users can install the complete ECDICT data for offline lookup.
Complete Rust rewrite with a Qt Bridge and Kirigami interface. Dictionary parsing, persistence, search, rendering, and file work now run in Rust workers outside the UI thread.
Packaging fix that bundles the Qt, Kirigami, and Qt WebEngine runtime files required to show the application window.
Packaging maintenance release with smaller Linux packages, consistent three-segment versioning, and supported GitHub Actions.
